height.description: Table's height. By default it has an auto height. If its value is a number, the height is measured in pixels; if its value is a string, the value will be assigned to element's style.height, the height is affected by external styles
height.description_zh: Table 的高度，默认为自动高度。如果 height 为 number 类型，单位 px；如果 height 为 string 类型，则这个高度会设置为 Table 的 style.height 的值，Table 的高度会受控于外部样式。

max-height.description: Table's max-height. The legal value is a number or the height in px
max-height.description_zh: Table 的最大高度。合法的值为数字或者单位为 px 的高度。

fit.description: Whether width of column automatically fits its container

current-row-key.description: Key of current row, a set only prop
current-row-key.description_zh: 当前行的 key，只写属性

:row-class-name.description: Function that returns custom class names for a row, or a string assigning class names for every row
:row-class-name.type: Function(data: { row: any, rowIndex: number }) => string | string
:row-class-name.description_zh: 行的 className 的回调方法，也可以使用字符串为所有行设置一个固定的 className。

:row-style.description: Function that returns custom style for a row, or an object assigning custom style for every row
:row-style.type: Function(data: { row: any, rowIndex: number }) => CSSProperties | object
:row-style.description_zh: 行的 style 的回调方法，也可以使用一个固定的 Object 为所有行设置一样的 Style。

:cell-class-name.description: Function that returns custom class names for a cell, or a string assigning class names for every cell
:cell-class-name.type: Function(data: { row: any, column: any, rowIndex: number, columnIndex: number }) => string | string
:cell-class-name.description_zh: 单元格的 className 的回调方法，也可以使用字符串为所有单元格设置一个固定的 className。

:cell-style.description: Function that returns custom style for a cell, or an object assigning custom style for every cell
:cell-style.type: Function(data: { row: any, column: any, rowIndex: number, columnIndex: number }) => CSSProperties | object
:cell-style.description_zh: 单元格的 style 的回调方法，也可以使用一个固定的 Object 为所有单元格设置一样的 Style。

:header-row-class-name.description: Function that returns custom class names for a row in table header, or a string assigning class names for every row in table header
:header-row-class-name.type: Function(data: { row: any, rowIndex: number }) => string | string
:header-row-class-name.description_zh: 表头行的 className 的回调方法，也可以使用字符串为所有表头行设置一个固定的 className。

:header-row-style.description: Function that returns custom style for a row in table header, or an object assigning custom style for every row in table header
:header-row-style.type: Function(data: { row: any, rowIndex: number }) => CSSProperties | object
:header-row-style.description_zh: 表头行的 style 的回调方法，也可以使用一个固定的 Object 为所有表头行设置一样的 Style。

:header-cell-class-name.description: Function that returns custom class names for a cell in table header, or a string assigning class names for every cell in table header
:header-cell-class-name.type: Function(data: { row: any, column: any, rowIndex: number, columnIndex: number }) => string | string
:header-cell-class-name.description_zh: 表头单元格的 className 的回调方法，也可以使用字符串为所有表头单元格设置一个固定的 className。

:header-cell-style.description: Function that returns custom style for a cell in table header, or an object assigning custom style for every cell in table header
:header-cell-style.type: Function(data: { row: any, column: any, rowIndex: number, columnIndex: number }) => CSSProperties | object
:header-cell-style.description_zh: 表头单元格的 style 的回调方法，也可以使用一个固定的 Object 为所有表头单元格设置一样的 Style。

:row-key.description: Key of row data, used for optimizing rendering. Required if reserve-selection is on or display tree data. When its type is String, multi-level access is supported, e.g. user.info.id, but user.info[0].id is not supported, in which case Function should be used
:row-key.description_zh: 行数据的 Key，用来优化 Table 的渲染；在使用 reserve-selection 功能与显示树形数据时，该属性是必填的。类型为 String 时，支持多层访问：user.info.id，但不支持 user.info[0].id，此种情况请使用 Function。

empty-text.description: Displayed text when data is empty. You can customize this area with #empty
empty-text.description_zh: 空数据时显示的文本内容，也可以通过 #empty 设置

default-expand-all.description: Whether expand all rows by default, works when the table has a column type="expand" or contains tree structure data
default-expand-all.description_zh: 是否默认展开所有行，当 Table 包含展开行存在或者为树形表格时有效

:expand-row-keys.description: Set expanded rows by this prop, prop's value is the keys of expand rows, you should set row-key before using this prop
:expand-row-keys.description_zh: 可以通过该属性设置 Table 目前的展开行，需要设置 row-key 属性才能使用，该属性为展开行的 keys 数组。

:default-sort.description: Set the default sort column and order. Property prop is used to set default sort column, property order is used to set default sort order
:default-sort.default: if prop is set, and order is not set, then order is default to ascending
:default-sort.description_zh: 默认的排序列的 prop 和顺序。它的prop属性指定默认的排序的列，order指定默认排序的顺序

tooltip-effect.description: The effect of the overflow tooltip

:tooltip-options.description: The options for the overflow tooltip
:tooltip-options.default: { enterable: true, placement: 'top', showArrow: true, hideAfter: 200, popperOptions: { strategy: 'fixed' } }

append-filter-panel-to.description: Which element the filter panels appends to
append-filter-panel-to.description_zh: 筛选面板附加到的元素

show-summary.description: Whether to display a summary row
show-summary.description_zh: 是否在表尾显示合计行

sum-text.description: Displayed text for the first column of summary row

:summary-method.type: Function(data: { columns: any[], data: any[] }) => (VNode | string)[]
:summary-method.description_zh: 自定义的合计计算方法

:span-method.description: Method that returns rowspan and colspan
:span-method.type: Function(data: { row: any, column: any, rowIndex: number, columnIndex: number }) => number[] | { rowspan: number, colspan: number } | void
:span-method.description_zh: 合并行或列的计算方法

select-on-indeterminate.description: Controls the behavior of master checkbox in multi-select tables when only some rows are selected (but not all). If true, all rows will be selected, else deselected
select-on-indeterminate.description_zh: 在多选表格中，当仅有部分行被选中时，点击表头的多选框时的行为。若为 true，则选中所有行；若为 false，则取消选择所有行

:indent.description_zh: 展示树形数据时，树节点的缩进

lazy.description_zh: 是否懒加载子节点数据

:load.description: Method for loading child row data, only works when lazy is true
:load.type: Function(row: any, treeNode: TreeNode, resolve: (data: any[]) => void) => void
:load.description_zh: 加载子节点数据的函数，lazy 为 true 时生效，函数第二个参数包含了节点的层级信息

:tree-props.type: { hasChildren?: string, children?: string, checkStrictly?: boolean }
:tree-props.description_zh: 渲染嵌套数据的配置选项

table-layout.description: Sets the algorithm used to lay out table cells, rows, and columns

show-overflow-tooltip.description: Whether to hide extra content and show them in a tooltip when hovering on the cell. It will affect all the table columns
show-overflow-tooltip.description_zh: 当内容过长被隐藏时显示 tooltip

flexible.description: Ensure main axis minimum-size doesn't follow the content
flexible.description_zh: 确保主轴最小尺寸不遵循内容

scrollbar-tabindex.description_zh: 正文滚动条的包装容器 tabindex

allow-drag-last-column.description: Whether to allow drag the last column
allow-drag-last-column.description_zh: 是否允许拖拽最后一列

:tooltip-formatter.description: Customize tooltip content when using show-overflow-tooltip
:tooltip-formatter.type: Function(data: { row: any, column: any, cellValue: any }) => VNode | string
:tooltip-formatter.description_zh: 使用 show-overflow-tooltip 时，自定义 tooltip 内容

events.name: select
events.description: Triggers when user clicks the checkbox in a row
events.description_zh: 当用户手动勾选数据行的 Checkbox 时触发的事件

events.name: select-all
events.description: Triggers when user clicks the checkbox in table header
events.description_zh: 当用户手动勾选全选 Checkbox 时触发的事件

events.name: selection-change
events.description_zh: 当选择项发生变化时会触发该事件

events.name: cell-mouse-enter
events.description: Triggers when hovering into a cell
events.params: (row: any, column: any, cell: HTMLTableCellElement, event: Event) => void
events.description_zh: 当单元格 hover 进入时会触发该事件

events.name: cell-mouse-leave
events.description: Triggers when hovering out of a cell
events.params: (row: any, column: any, cell: HTMLTableCellElement, event: Event) => void
events.description_zh: 当单元格 hover 退出时会触发该事件

events.name: cell-click
events.params: (row: any, column: any, cell: HTMLTableCellElement, event: Event) => void
events.description_zh: 当某个单元格被点击时会触发该事件

events.name: cell-dblclick
events.description: Triggers when double clicking a cell
events.params: (row: any, column: any, cell: HTMLTableCellElement, event: Event) => void
events.description_zh: 当某个单元格被双击时会触发该事件

events.name: cell-contextmenu
events.description: Triggers when user right clicks on a cell
events.params: (row: any, column: any, cell: HTMLTableCellElement, event: Event) => void
events.description_zh: 当某个单元格被鼠标右键点击时会触发该事件

events.name: row-click
events.params: (row: any, column: any, event: Event) => void
events.description_zh: 当某一行被点击时会触发该事件

events.name: row-contextmenu
events.description: Triggers when user right clicks on a row
events.params: (row: any, column: any, event: Event) => void
events.description_zh: 当某一行被鼠标右键点击时会触发该事件

events.name: row-dblclick
events.description: Triggers when double clicking a row
events.params: (row: any, column: any, event: Event) => void
events.description_zh: 当某一行被双击时会触发该事件

events.name: header-click
events.description: Triggers when clicking a column header
events.description_zh: 当某一列的表头被点击时会触发该事件

events.name: header-contextmenu
events.description: Triggers when user right clicks on a column header
events.description_zh: 当某一列的表头被鼠标右键点击时触发该事件

events.name: sort-change
events.params: (data: {column: any, prop: string, order: any }) => void
events.description_zh: 当表格的排序条件发生变化的时候会触发该事件

events.name: filter-change
events.description: Column's key. If you need to use the filter-change event, this attribute is mandatory to identify which column is being filtered
events.description_zh: 当表格的筛选条件发生变化的时候会触发该事件，参数的值是一个对象，对象的 key 是 column 的 columnKey，对应的 value 为用户选择的筛选条件的数组。

events.name: current-change
events.description_zh: 当表格的当前行发生变化的时候会触发该事件，如果要高亮当前行，请打开表格的 highlight-current-row 属性

events.name: header-dragend
events.description: Triggers after changing a column's width by dragging the column header's border
events.params: (newWidth: number, oldWidth: number, column: any, event: MouseEvent) => void
events.description_zh: 当拖动表头改变了列的宽度的时候会触发该事件

events.name: expand-change
events.description: Triggers when user expands or collapses a row (for expandable table, second param is expandedRows; for tree Table, second param is expanded)
events.params: (row: any, expandedRows: any[]) => void & (row: any, expanded: boolean) => void
events.description_zh: 当用户对某一行展开或者关闭的时候会触发该事件（展开行时，回调的第二个参数为 expandedRows；树形表格时第二参数为 expanded）

slots.name: append
slots.description: Contents to be inserted after the last row. You may need this slot if you want to implement infinite scroll for the table. This slot will be displayed above the summary row if there is one.
slots.description_zh: 插入至表格最后一行之后的内容，如果需要对表格的内容进行无限滚动操作，可能需要用到这个 slot。若表格有合计行，该 slot 会位于合计行之上。

slots.name: empty
slots.description: You can customize content when data is empty
slots.description_zh: 当数据为空时自定义的内容

exposed.name: clearSelection
exposed.description: Used in multiple selection Table, clear user selection
exposed.description_zh: 用于多选表格，清空用户的选择

exposed.name: toggleRowSelection
exposed.description: Used in multiple selection Table, toggle if a certain row is selected. With the second parameter, you can directly set if this row is selected
exposed.description_zh: 用于多选表格，切换某一行的选中状态，如果使用了第二个参数，则是设置这一行选中与否
exposed.detail: (row: any, selected?: boolean, ignoreSelectable = true) => void

exposed.name: toggleAllSelection
exposed.description: Used in multiple selection Table, toggle select all and deselect all
exposed.description_zh: 用于多选表格，切换所有行的选中状态

exposed.name: toggleRowExpansion
exposed.description: Used in expandable Table or tree Table, toggle if a certain row is expanded. With the second parameter, you can directly set if this row is expanded or collapsed
exposed.description_zh: 用于可展开表格与树形表格，切换某一行的展开状态，如果使用了第二个参数，则是设置这一行展开与否

exposed.name: setCurrentRow
exposed.description: Used in single selection Table, set a certain row selected. If called without any parameter, it will clear selection
exposed.description_zh: 用于单选表格，设定某一行为选中行，如果调用时不加参数，则会取消目前高亮行的选中状态。

exposed.name: clearSort
exposed.description: Clear sorting, restore data to the original order
exposed.description_zh: 用于清空排序条件，数据会恢复成未排序的状态

exposed.name: clearFilter
exposed.description: Clear filters of the columns whose columnKey are passed in. If no params, clear all filters
exposed.description_zh: 不传入参数时用于清空所有过滤条件，数据会恢复成未过滤的状态，也可传入由columnKey组成的数组以清除指定列的过滤条件

exposed.name: doLayout
exposed.description: Refresh the layout of Table. When the visibility of Table changes, you may need to call this method to get a correct layout
exposed.description_zh: 对 Table 进行重新布局。当 Table 或其祖先元素由隐藏切换为显示时，可能需要调用此方法

exposed.name: sort
exposed.description: Sort Table manually. Property prop is used to set sort column, property order is used to set sort order
exposed.description_zh: 手动对 Table 进行排序。参数prop属性指定排序列，order指定排序顺序。

exposed.name: scrollTo
exposed.description: Scrolls to a particular set of coordinates

exposed.name: updateKeyChildren
exposed.description: Used in lazy Table, must set rowKey, update key children
exposed.description_zh: 用于懒加载表格，必须设置 rowKey，更新键的子项

TreeNode.name: noLazyChildren
TreeNode.description: Whether node has no lazy-loaded children
